english.note: Department states these minima for graduate-assistantship eligibility. Previous US education, training or residence does not automatically exempt applicants; Graduate College approval required for language-test waiver.

applicationFee.note: Central waivers limited to listed participating-program categories, with documentation. GEM requires US citizenship/permanent residence. Other applicants may ask their program whether it will cover the fee; approval is not guaranteed. Confirm international eligibility for an applicable category.

documents: Personal statement describing research experience, research interests, professional objectives and departmental fit
requirements.note: Minimum GPA 2.8 overall and 3.0 in sciences. Preparation: two years biological sciences, one year mathematics preferably calculus/statistics, one year physics, one year general chemistry and a course in organic chemistry. PhD students complete 2–3 first-year rotations before choosing a mentor.

funding.note: All research PhD students receive assistantship support. PhD graduate assistants also receive full tuition scholarships and university-subsidized health insurance.
